title: Did TSLA's Jul 22 earnings miss actually break it from auto/EV peers?
description: Treated: TSLA. Donors: F, GM, RIVN (traditional + EV auto peers) — hand-picked, not algorithmic. Treatment date is the Jul 22 earnings report (auto gross margins 16.3% vs 18.4% expected, EPS $0.33 vs $0.55 consensus, FCF went negative on AI/robotics capex). Tests whether the post-earnings selloff is a real, company-specific fundamentals break from the auto sector, or whether TSLA was already diverging from these peers beforehand for unrelated reasons. Result: fails the fit-quality gate — see tsla_earnings_miss_growth_peers for the follow-up with a different donor pool.
